title: 第一卷 第15章 赶海泡妞两不误
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
李华看她这样，把抓到的八爪鱼，用海水洗洗，随手扔到张春妮的水桶里：“不学算了。”

    说完。

    他神色如常的走开。

    张春妮松了一口气，继续找海鲜。

    李华偷摸的看张春妮反应，见其没什么反应，也是松了一口气。

    别看他表面上镇定自若。

    实际上心里也是直打鼓。

    怕自己吓到张春妮。

    这也说明，张春妮并不反感和他的接触。

    张春妮没李华那么多心思，她现在一心只想抓海鲜。

    抓到海鲜卖钱。

    这样阿奶就有钱看病挂水了。

    今天。

    阿奶身体不舒服，她送到村医那里挂水。

    还好昨天跟着李华赶海，赚了二十七块钱。

    不然。

    今天阿奶挂水都没有钱。

    而今天赶海抓的海鲜比昨天多很多，肯定能卖更多钱，这样阿奶就可以去镇上卫生所看病。

    当搬开石头，没发现海鲜，她会失望的撅撅嘴。

    当发现海鲜，她高兴的把眼睛笑成月牙。

    李华虽然也在抓海鲜，但一直都在关注着张春妮，看着她一颦一笑，李华真确感受到了他重生一场的意义。

    张春妮已经走上了一条和她上一世完全不一样的人生之路。

    而他的人生。

    也因张春妮，也会有极大的不同。

    至少。

    不会打光棍了。

    李华晒然一笑。

    张春妮一抬头，撞上李华一直盯着她的视线，那火辣辣的目光，烧的她心慌，下意识的躲开视线。

    过了一会。

    她偷偷的扭头看李华。

    结果，又和李华的视线碰上。

    张春妮就跟被踩了尾巴的猫一样，差点炸了。

    她不明白李华干嘛那么看自己。

    不敢想。

    也不敢问。

    或者说，她害怕了。

    她冷不丁想起了刚才李华为了逼她跟着说的那句“要不你和我谈对象吧”。

    这时。

    阿青走了过来：“哥，你刚才说的几个点都没有找到海参。”

    李华说道；“找不到了？”

    阿青点点头。
content_en:
Seeing her like this, Li Hua washed the caught octopus with sea water and threw it into Zhang Chuni's bucket: "Forget it if you don't want to learn."

    Finished.

    He walked away with a normal expression.

    Zhang Chuni breathed a sigh of relief and continued looking for seafood.

    Li Hua secretly watched Zhang Chunni's reaction and was relieved when he saw that there was no reaction.

    Despite his calm appearance.

    In fact, my heart was pounding.

    I was afraid that I would scare Zhang Chunni.

    This also shows that Zhang Chunni does not dislike contact with him.

    Zhang Chuni doesn't think as much as Li Hua. She just wants to catch seafood now.

    Catch seafood and sell it for money.

    In this way, grandma can afford to pay for medical treatment.

    today.

    Grandma was feeling unwell, so she was sent to the village doctor for fluids.

    Fortunately, I followed Li Hua to the sea yesterday and made twenty-seven yuan.

    otherwise.

    Today, grandma has no money even for water.

    The seafood caught in the sea today is much more than yesterday, and it will definitely be sold for more money, so that Ah Nai can go to the town health center to see a doctor.

    When the stone is removed and no seafood is found, she will pout in disappointment.

    When she discovered seafood, she smiled happily and her eyes turned into crescent moons.

    Although Li Hua was also catching seafood, he had been paying attention to Zhang Chunni. Watching her smile, Li Hua truly felt the meaning of his rebirth.

    Zhang Chunni has embarked on a completely different life path from her previous life.

    And his life.

    Also because of Zhang Chunni, there will be a huge difference.

    At least.

    I won’t be a bachelor anymore.

    Li Hua smiled brightly.

    Zhang Chuni raised her head and met Li Hua's eyes, which had been staring at her. The fiery gaze made her panic and she subconsciously averted her eyes.

    After a while.

    She secretly turned to look at Li Hua.

    As a result, Li Hua's eyes met again.

    Zhang Chunni was like a cat whose tail had been stepped on, and almost exploded.

    She didn't understand why Li Hua thought of herself so much.

    I dare not think about it.

    Don't dare to ask.

    In other words, she was scared.

    She suddenly remembered what Li Hua had said just now to force her to follow suit, "Why don't you talk to me about a date?"

    At this time.

    Ah Qing came over and said, "Brother, we didn't find any sea cucumbers at the points you mentioned just now."

    Li Hua said; "Can't find it?"

    Ah Qing nodded.
title_en: Volume 1, Chapter 15: There is no mistake in catching up with girls
